C1.type: surface move (mutation-outcome semantics: the survivor-resolution rule) on the routed round-42 survivor set
C1.statement: The two survivors of the round-42 mutant set are resolved under the pre-declared rule K/D/E/U: outflag_no_parse_args_check is killed by a new reachable-code fixture (F11_outflag_namespace) and method_fold_several_returns is classified dead_code_only by the declared dead-code construct with a differential probe, leaving five killed and one dead-code-only and zero unresolved, with the round-42 mutant declaration unchanged.

rule.K_kill: a mutant is killed when the round-43 battery (12 fixtures + 3 live sites) produces at least one FAIL under the round-42 exit-plus-FAIL oracle (exit 0, parseable output, a case differs from its declared classification), and the killing fixture contains no runtime-unreachable statement
rule.D_dead_code_only: a mutant that survives K is dead_code_only when every case on which it differs from the pristine tool is a fixture whose source contains a statement after an unconditional return/raise in the same block
rule.E_equivalent: a mutant with no differing case over the declared corpus (reserved; not reached this round)
rule.U_unresolved: not_killed (a reachable-input survivor), runtime_error (non-zero exit, traceback or unparseable output - PIT Run error / Stryker RuntimeError, neither counted as a kill), or apply_error (the declared edit does not apply exactly once)

C1.mutant_set: .ufo/evidence/round-42/census/mutants.json at REV, unchanged (six mutants, classes attr/method/outflag)
C1.do_nothing_control: (1) the round-42 battery (ten fixtures, no F11/F12) kills 4 of 6 and cannot reach mutants_killed=5; receipt .ufo/evidence/round-43/control/c1-round42-battery.stdout. (2) the pristine v4 tool passes 12/12 fixtures (green control). (3) each named survivor is probed directly before the fixtures exist; receipt .ufo/evidence/round-43/control/c1-probe-survivors.stdout

C2.type: record-agreement counter extended with two classes (lowest non-retired axis)
C2.statement: The lane's self-assessment records agree with the observed repo state across seven classes: the five round-42 classes (m6 registry count, m7 mined S-ids, m8 path cites, m10 presence receipts, m11 revision reachability) plus m12 (the newest SCORECARD round block declares the next round's planned claims) and m13 (the newest standing sources-registry counting command is census-valid and load-bearing on an indented-row mirror), with total=0.
C2.target: C2_R43_PASS=true: self_pin=1 classes=7 m6=0 m7=0 m8=0 m10=0 m11=0 m12=0 m13=0 total=0
C2.before_state: m12=1 (the round-42 SCORECARD block carries no 'Planned (round 43)' line; the last such line is 'Planned (round 41)') and m13=1 (the newest standing sources-registry row cites the column-zero pattern grep -cE '^\| S[0-9]{3} \|', which counts N-1 on a mirror with one row indented two spaces where the census-valid pattern counts N)

classes.m6: the newest standing sources-registry row's stated row count equals the census-valid registry row count
classes.m7: every S-id cited by the round-42/43 records as a source is a mined row: staged:S### package tokens and 'Next unused id: S###' declarations are masked first
classes.m8: every backtick cite under corpus/, tools/, .ufo/, plans/, reports/ or the declared root files resolves at REV (after :NN and brace normalization); a bare seat-report filename is not a repo path
classes.m10: no presence receipt under .ufo/waves asserts present/absent contrary to the tree; a receipt named in another receipt's supersedes is history and its claims are not counted
classes.m11: every 40-hex revision cited by those records resolves in the lane
classes.m12: the newest '## Round N' SCORECARD block carries '**Planned (round N+1):**'
classes.m13: the newest standing sources-registry row's counting command names the census-valid 0-3-space pattern, and an indented-row mirror proves the difference (column0 = N-1, census-valid = N)

C3.statement: tools/staged-id-guard.py answers the round-42 post-append hazard before any append: it extracts collisions with the census-valid 0-3-space pattern, refuses a colliding row with no document, dedupes a staged row whose document the registry already holds, refuses its own naive arithmetic map because its targets are still staged ids, and admits only a by-document map (held rows dedupe; new documents take ids at or above the safe floor).
